_comment: OPTIONAL override. The materializer auto-fetches the pinned Synthea jar (checksum-verified, cached under benchmark/.cache/synthea/) using the recipe's dataset.syntheaVersion, so this config is NOT required. Copy to executors.config.json only to override: point jar at a locally-built synthea-with-dependencies-<version>.jar and/or set a non-default java binary; a present config WINS over the auto-fetch.
